description: Air  Services  negotiations between Sri Lanka and Ukraine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-08
decision_details_body:
-The Aeronautical  Authorities  of  Sri Lanka and Ukraine have held discussions in October 2010 with the view to finalize and Air Services Agreement to facilitate operations between the two countries.  The following have been mainly agreed to by the authorities of both countries: 
 
*	designate one or more airlines for the purpose of  operating the agreed services on the specific routes.

*	each party to operate 7 frequencies per week for the IATA Winter Season 2010/2011.

*	consider further extensions up to 14 flights per week starting from IATA Summer Season 2011 between the two countries. 

	Cabinet approval was granted to sign the initialed Air Services Agreement and to take all necessary steps for its entry into force.

description: Establishment of a National Centre for Hearing and Speech Impaired at Narahenpita
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-08
decision_details_body: - The Dialog Axiata, PLC (formerly known as Dialog Telecom PLC) has expressed to the Government of Sri Lanka, the intent to gift a fully fledged centre for the hearing and speech impaired people of the coutnry.  Under  this project it is proposed to construct a three storied building on a block of land identified in Narahenpita belonging to the Ministry of Health.  A space at the ground floor of the building is to be allocated for the National Cancer Prevention and Early Detection Centre.  Cabinet approval was granted to implement the project with financial assistance of Rs.120 million to be provided by the company.  The Centre will be managed by the Ministry of Health.

description: Ninth Session of the Joint Commission for Economic Co-operation between Sri Lanka and Iran 13-15 September 2010, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-08
decision_details_body: - the 9th Session was held in Colombo from 13th to 15th September 2010.  Iran is Sri Lanka's 6th largest trading partner recording a total value of two-way trade of nearly US $992 million in 2009.  With regard to the main export item of tea, Iran agreed to study the inclusion of preferential tariff quota on annual basis for tea exported from Sri Lanka and agreed that part of the quota could be used for packaging of Sri Lankan tea in Free Trade Zones in Iran by Sri Lankan companies or joint ventures formed with Iranian and Sri Lankan companies.  Covering approval of the Cabinet was granted for signing of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) of the 9th Session of the two countries.

description: Introduction of Natural Gas to meet energy needs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-08
decision_details_body:
- Natural Gas is the fastest growing energy source in the world and the most flexible fuel that can be used directly for transport and power generation.  Natural gas is a raw material for the production of a variety of chemicals, plastics and Urea.  It has been identified that the Power Sector, Transport Sector, Fertilizer Subsidy Programme as well as domestic and industrial usages would benefit by the introduction of natural gas.  Some of the advantages are - 

	*	Liquid Natural Gas (LNG) is cheaper in price than any Liquid Petroleum Products and even LP Gas.

	*	LNG is a cleaner fuel when compared to coal, diesel, petrol and other fuel
		*	its high purity results in generating energy at a cheaper cos

	Cabinet approval was granted to appoint a High Powered Steering Committee to implement the above policy and to authorize the Ministry of Petroleum Industries to explore possibility of arranging LNG on long-term supply arrangement on Government to Government basis.

description: Providing Relief to the Families to be Resettled due to Acquisition of Lands for Kaluganga Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-29
decision_details_body: - Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Projects were inaugurated in 2007 to remedy the severe water shortage for Agriculture in the North Central Province and to provide drinking water to the people in Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Trincomalee and Matale Districts. description: Recovery of a percentage of cost incurred for a formal disciplinary inquiry, from an accused Public Officer found guilty
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-12-29
decision_details_body: - Public Officers engaged in fraudulent activities in the discharge of their duties are being dealt with in terms of the provisions of the Establishments Code and the entire cost of the disciplinary inquiry is presently being borne by the Government.  This is apart from the legal proceedings, if any, to be conducted in this regard. Cabinet of Ministers considered the recommendation on this matter made by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Establishment Matters after a detailed discussion by the Cabinet Sub-Committee,  to recover at least a certain percentage of the cost incurred on same by the Ministry or Department, in keeping with the provisions of Chapter XLVIII of the Establishments Code, when an accused Public Officer is found guilty at the formal disciplinary inquiry.  Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted to include provisions in the Establishments Code for the recovery of 25% of the cost of the said inquiry or Rs.30,000/- whichever is less, to be recovered in not more than 24 installments, when an accused Public Officer is found guilty, in addition to other punishments imposed as disciplinary order.  Government is of the view that this measure will, to a certain extent, compel Public Officers to be more cautious and desist from engaging in fraudulent activities in future.
